title: Serry Beach Resort
description: Well located in Hurghada, Serry Beach Resort provides air-conditioned rooms, an outdoor swimming pool, free WiFi and a fitness center. With a private beach area, the property also features a terrace, as well as a bar. The property has a kids' club, room service and currency exchange for guests. At the hotel, each room is equipped with a closet. Each room has an electric tea pot and a private bathroom with a shower and free toiletries, while selected rooms come with a kitchenette equipped with a microwave. Guest rooms at Serry Beach Resort are equipped with a flat-screen TV with satellite channels and a safety deposit box. The breakfast offers buffet, continental or Full English/Irish options. At the accommodation you'll find a restaurant serving African, Middle Eastern and Seafood cuisine. Vegetarian, halal and gluten-free options can also be requested. Serry Beach Resort has a playground. You can play pool, table tennis, and darts at the 5-star hotel. Speaking Arabic, German, English and French, staff at the reception can help you plan your stay. Popular points of interest near the hotel include Albatros White Beach, Marina Sports Club Beach and Old Vic Beach. Hurghada International Airport is 1.2 miles away, and the property offers a paid airport shuttle service.

description: Nestled among lush gardens with palm trees, Giftun Azur Resort features 7 restaurants and 7 bars. It has outdoor pools, and spacious rooms with sea, pool or garden views. Giftun Azur Resort offers rooms, decorated in neutral colors. Each of the air-conditioned rooms has a satellite TV and a mini-bar. The hotel’s main restaurant “Sunny” serves International and local dishes for breakfast and dinner. Oriental Restaurant “El Dawar”offers authentic Arabic cuisine; Our A la Carte Restaurants against charge : “La Piazzetta” Restaurant has Italian specialties, also there are Fish Restaurant ”Pirates of Red Sea”, Brazilian and Mexican Restaurant “El Gaucho” and “Asian Corner” with Teppaniakki table. Guests can visit the on-site bars to enjoy a cocktail, or just relax on the sun loungers by the pool. The younger guests can entertain themselves in outdoor playground areas. Giftun’s water sports activities include diving, snorkeling, banana boat ride and more. Hurghada International Airport is 1.9 mi away. A car rental service is available.

title: Hurghada Marriott Beach Resort
description: This Marriott resort features an extensive pool, health club and its own island with a private beach. All rooms offer views of the Red Sea.It is a 10-minute drive from Marina Hurghada. The rooms are equipped with 32-inch satellite TV, a mini-bar and safe box. The bathroom includes a hairdryer and bidet.Some rooms include a balcony with a sea view. Each morning, an extensive breakfast buffet is served at Shorouk restaurant or on the outdoor terrace with sea views. Lunch snacks are available from the poolside restaurant and the Tuscany offers fine Al Fresco dining. Located in a separate building, the hotel’s health club offers massage rooms. Sports-minded guests can play tennis or enjoy working out at Marriott’s extensive gym. For guests’ convenience, the Hurghada Marriott Red Sea Resort provides beach towels and sun loungers. The hotel’s large open patio offers a pleasant place to relax with an Egyptian water pipe or a drink. Hurghada Marriott is located 5 mi from the downtown Al-Dahar district. The airport is just a 10-minute drive away.

title: Brothers Pyramids View
description: Boasting one of the best views of the Great Pyramids, the Brothers Pyramids View is in Cairo (Giza) across from the Great Pyramids and the Sphinx. The Brothers Pyramids View is in a traditional area of Cairo (Giza) that is up-and-coming and being revitalized, just like the New Grand Egyptian Museum, a short drive up the street. The hotel is located on the fourth and seventh floors of a new building and offers a variety of rooms from standard to Luxury with a view, for individuals and your family. To best help you recognize the building, we have added a photo of the building in your Room Photo Gallery. Among the Hotel's facilities are a restaurant for breakfast and drinks, offsite food service, a 24-hour front desk and Free WiFi. The Brothers Pyramids View's roof terrace has a grand view of the three Great Pyramids. The roof terrace restaurant is open for breakfast from 8:30am to 10am. It is open for drinks and offsite food service all day until 12am. Continental and vegetarian breakfast options are available every morning. At the hotel, all the rooms come with air conditioning, comfortable chairs, coffee and tea in the room, a flat-screen TV with satellite channels, and a private bathroom with a shower and free toiletries. Hair dryers by request. At the Brothers Pyramids View, rooms come with 100% cotton bed linen and towels. The Giza Pyramids and Sphinx are 1.1 mi (5 min) from the hotel. The Grand Egyptian Museum is 3.8 mi (11 min) from the Hotel. The Cairo Tower is 6.8 mi from the property. The nearest airport is Sphinx International, 18 mi from Brothers Pyramids view, and the property offers a paid airport shuttle service.

title: Brothers Pyramids View
description: Boasting one of the best views of the Great Pyramids, the Brothers Pyramids View is in Cairo (Giza) across from the Great Pyramids and the Sphinx. The Brothers Pyramids View is in a traditional area of Cairo (Giza) that is up-and-coming and being revitalized, just like the New Grand Egyptian Museum, a short drive up the street. The hotel is located on the fourth and seventh floors of a new building and offers a variety of rooms from standard to Luxury with a view, for individuals and your family. To best help you recognize the building, we have added a photo of the building in your Room Photo Gallery. Among the Hotel's facilities are a restaurant for breakfast and drinks, offsite food service, a 24-hour front desk and Free WiFi. The Brothers Pyramids View's roof terrace has a grand view of the three Great Pyramids. The roof terrace restaurant is open for breakfast from 8:30am to 10am. It is open for drinks and offsite food service all day until 12am. Continental and vegetarian breakfast options are available every morning. At the hotel, all the rooms come with air conditioning, comfortable chairs, coffee and tea in the room, a flat-screen TV with satellite channels, and a private bathroom with a shower and free toiletries. Hair dryers by request. At the Brothers Pyramids View, rooms come with 100% cotton bed linen and towels. The Giza Pyramids and Sphinx are 1.1 mi (5 min) from the hotel. The Grand Egyptian Museum is 3.8 mi (11 min) from the Hotel. The Cairo Tower is 6.8 mi from the property. The nearest airport is Sphinx International, 18 mi from Brothers Pyramids view, and the property offers a paid airport shuttle service.

title: Hurghada Marriott Beach Resort
description: This Marriott resort features an extensive pool, health club and its own island with a private beach. All rooms offer views of the Red Sea.It is a 10-minute drive from Marina Hurghada. The rooms are equipped with 32-inch satellite TV, a mini-bar and safe box. The bathroom includes a hairdryer and bidet.Some rooms include a balcony with a sea view. Each morning, an extensive breakfast buffet is served at Shorouk restaurant or on the outdoor terrace with sea views. Lunch snacks are available from the poolside restaurant and the Tuscany offers fine Al Fresco dining. Located in a separate building, the hotel’s health club offers massage rooms. Sports-minded guests can play tennis or enjoy working out at Marriott’s extensive gym. For guests’ convenience, the Hurghada Marriott Red Sea Resort provides beach towels and sun loungers. The hotel’s large open patio offers a pleasant place to relax with an Egyptian water pipe or a drink. Hurghada Marriott is located 5 mi from the downtown Al-Dahar district. The airport is just a 10-minute drive away.

title: Four Seasons Resort Sharm El Sheikh
description: Rediscover World-Class Luxury at Four Seasons Resort Sharm El Sheikh, Egypt Located on a one-mile stretch of private beachfront, Four Seasons Resort Sharm El Sheikh, Egypt is a luxurious oasis between the desert and the reef with year-round sunshine, sleek modern accommodations and panoramic Red Sea views. Boasting 5 outdoor pools, 10 al fresco dining experiences, a highly acclaimed spa, fun-filled Kids For All Seasons club and an expertly run PADI dove center combined with one of the best house reefs in the region and a funicular that transports guests from peak to beach. The resort’s spacious guest rooms and oversize suites range from one to four bedrooms, with a choice of modern design or traditional Arabian décor. All featuring a private balcony or terrace, some with a private pool and kitchen or kitchenette – ideal for families, group travelers and couples. Each accommodations offers comfortable living areas with a flat-screen TV, the legendary Four Seasons bed and expansive spa-like marble bathrooms aglow with sunlight. Four Seasons Resort Sharm El Sheikh offers a stellar culinary experience ranging from Pan-Asian, Italian, Lebanese and Latin American cuisines as well as a bare-foot chic beach bar and authentic lounge with daily live entertainment. The resort offers a special program for younger guests with a daily schedule of games, arts and crafts, cultural immersion and active play including a space reserved just for teens as well as professional babysitting services in addition to 4 tennis courts. The Spa blends the latest wellness innovations with authentic Egyptian traditions. Offering 12 treatment rooms including a lavish couple’s suite and two outdoor cabanas facing the Red Sea, a lap pool, beauty salon and state-of-the-art fitness center. Other facilities include meeting and wedding venues with dedicated staff as well as expert concierge services. Four Seasons Resort Sharm El Sheikh is a 10-minute drive from Sharm El Sheikh International Airport, a 25-minute drive from Naama Bay. Old Sharm with its traditional markets is 40 minutes away by car.

Four Seasons Resort Sharm El Sheikh offers a stellar culinary experience ranging from Pan-Asian, Italian, Lebanese and Latin American cuisines as well as a bare-foot chic beach bar and authentic lounge with daily live entertainment. The resort offers a special program for younger guests with a daily schedule of games, arts and crafts, cultural immersion and active play including a space reserved just for teens as well as professional babysitting services in addition to 4 tennis courts. The Spa blends the latest wellness innovations with authentic Egyptian traditions. Offering 12 treatment rooms including a lavish couple’s suite and two outdoor cabanas facing the Red Sea, a lap pool, beauty salon and state-of-the-art fitness center. Other facilities include meeting and wedding venues with dedicated staff as well as expert concierge services. Four Seasons Resort Sharm El Sheikh is a 10-minute drive from Sharm El Sheikh International Airport, a 25-minute drive from Naama Bay. Old Sharm with its traditional markets is 40 minutes away by car.

The chalet features a pool with a view with a pool bar, as well as a fitness room and a 24-hour front desk. With direct access to a terrace with sea views, the spacious chalet consists of 2 bedrooms. The air-conditioned chalet also offers a flat-screen TV, a fully equipped kitchenette with kitchenware, a washing machine, and 2 bathrooms with a walk-in shower and a bidet. For added privacy, the accommodation has a private entrance and soundproofing. There is a coffee shop, and a mini-market is also available. For guests with children, the chalet provides an indoor play area, outdoor play equipment, and a baby safety gate. A private beach area can be found at Porto Sokhna Hotel VIP, along with a garden. Cairo International Airport is 98 miles away.

title: Tolip Resort El Galala Majestic
description: Located in Ain El-Sokhna, Tolip Resort El Galala Majestic offers 5-star resort overlooking the Red Sea and El-Galala Plateau. Swimming pools with bars, restaurants, a lobby lounge, WiFi access, a wellness center and spa are available at the property. All the rooms come with a LED TV, a mini-bar, a safe box, a hair dryer, tea/coffee facilities, an iron and an iron board. Villas and Chalets are fully-equipped with kitchen facilities. Units with a private balcony or a terrace can be found as well. The resort features a seasonal heated swimming pool, a well-equipped business area with meeting facilities, a five-a-side court, a 24-hour room service, a front desk and club car services. A clinic, a pharmacy, an ATM, a mini market and games room are available on-site. A range of activities such as water sports and daily evening entertainment with the animation team are available at the property. Free teleferique tour is offered. El Galala aqua park, Teleferique El Galala and the International El Galala Marina are nearby. Cairo is a 90-minute drive from TOLIP EL-Galala Majestic Resort. Heated swimming pool during Winter season free of charge for our inhouse guests. TOLIP EL-Galala Majestic Resort Teleferique Timing from 11:00AM till 16:30 PM daily except Tuesday, and close weekly on Tuesday due to Weekly Maintenance . Free drop and pick up Shuttle Bus from the hotel to Teleferique El Galala.

title: Tropitel Dahab Oasis
description: The 4-star Tropitel Dahab Oasis is located on the coast of Aqaba Gulf. The hotel has its own private beach, an outdoor swimming pool heated during winter and a diving center overlooking the Blue Hole diving spot. Tropitel Dahab Oasis’s rooms are air-conditioned and have satellite TV and balconies overlooking the Gulf or the desert. The hotel also offers a health club, sauna, steam room and massage. There is shopping arcade and currency exchange at the hotel. Guests can relax with drinks at either the beach bar or the poolside bar. There is also a dining room and terrace where breakfast, lunch and dinner is served. Evening meals have an international theme that changes regularly. The hotel is just 5 mi from Dahab city center and a 70-minute drive from Sharm El-Sheikh International Airport. This magnificent Hotel is only a 5-minute walk away from the world-renowned diving spot, The Blue Hole. The property rests in between the beautiful shoreline of the Red Sea and the grand mountains of Sinai, offering an unparalleled atmosphere and a serene view.

title: RockyHouse Homestay
description: RockyHouse Homestay in Dahab provides accommodations with a garden, a bar, and a shared lounge. A public bath is available for guests. The homestay provides an outdoor swimming pool with a pool bar, as well as a fitness room and a shared kitchen. All units have a shared bathroom, and certain units at the homestay have a patio. Buffet and vegetarian breakfast options with local specialities, fruit, and cheese are available. There is a coffee shop, and a grocery delivery service is also available. Guests can take advantage of yoga classes held on site. The area is popular for cycling, and bike rental is available at the homestay. Kids pool is also available at RockyHouse Homestay, while guests can also relax on the sun terrace. Dahab Beach is a 11-minute walk from the accommodation. Sharm el-Sheikh International Airport is 57 miles away, and the property offers a paid airport shuttle service.

Guests enjoy free WiFi, a modern restaurant, and a variety of amenities including air-conditioning, balconies, and private bathrooms. Comfortable Facilities The property features a 24-hour front desk, concierge service, and free parking. Additional services include a paid shuttle, outdoor fireplace, and family rooms. Free WiFi is available throughout the resort. Dining Experience The family-friendly restaurant serves halal and vegetarian meals with pizza options. Guests can enjoy lunch and dinner in a modern ambiance, making mealtimes enjoyable for all. Activities and Surroundings Ghazala Oasis offers snorkeling and scuba diving in the surrounding area. Dahab Beach is a 17-minute walk away, and Sharm el-Sheikh International Airport is 58 mi from the resort.

title: Dahab Divers
description: Dahab Divers Hotel features a dive center offering courses and equipment. It features air-conditioned rooms equipped with a flat-screen TV. It organizes tours and excursions. All rooms have a simple, modern décor and are equipped with satellite TV and a small sitting area. Each room has a private bathroom. Hotel Dahab Divers features a well-equipped dive center. Its trained instructors teach free diving and provide beginner courses. Dahab Divers can organize sightseeing trips to local attractions including Abu Gallum and Petra. Local excursions such as 4x4 safaris and camel trips can be arranged. It is located less than 37 miles from Sharm el-Sheikh International Airport.

description: Located in the heart of peaceful Dahab, this family-run hotel has an outdoor swimming pool and overlooks the Red Sea. Its diving center can organize snorkeling and scuba diving trips. Featuring flat-screen TVs, the air-conditioned rooms at the Acacia Dahab Hotel are fitted with tiled floors and wooden furniture. Free Wi-Fi is available in the hotel’s public areas. Sahara Restaurant and Grill serves Middle-Eastern and Mediterranean fusion cuisine. Guests can enjoy an informal drink at the Mazaj Cocktail Lounge, featuring live music and Oriental jazz as well as a free billiards table. The Acacia Dahab is located 1 hour’s drive from Sharm el Sheikh International Airport. Airport shuttle service can be arranged by the hotel’s 24-hour front desk.

title: Shams Hotel & Dive Centre
description: Shams Hotel offers a superb beach location in Dahab’s central Mashraba District. It includes Shams restaurant which overlooks the Red Sea. Free Wi-Fi is available in the coffee shop. Air-conditioned rooms and bungalows are simply decorated with private bathroom. Guests can enjoy Red Sea or garden views from their own balcony or terrace. Some have a satellite TV and mini-bar. Several restaurants and bars are within a 5-minute walk. Breakfast is taken in the restaurant or brought to your room. Shams has its own dove center for snorkeling and diving. The tour desk can organize car rental, bicycles or excursions to St. Catherine's Monastery and Mt. Sinai. The Blue Hole dove location is a 15-minute drive. Sharm el Sheikh International Airport is 56 mi away by car.

title: Resta Port Said Hotel
description: In a stunning location near the Mediterranean Sea, Resta Hotel overlooks passing boats and ships right at the entrance of the Suez Canal. It features a contemporary building and an outdoor pool. Fitted with typical Egyptian textiles, rooms at Resta Port Said Hotel come with large windows looking out onto the canal or the city. All rooms are air conditioned, equipped with satellite TVs and include private bathrooms. Guests can enjoy a fusion of Egyptian specialties and Italian classics at the hotel's restaurant. They can also enjoy drinks at the bar and relax on the terrace, facing the extensive gardens with swimming pool. Popular nearby attractions include the pharaonic ancient obelisks and the iconic Suez Canal Authority Headquarters, less than a 10-minute drive away. Free private parking is available on site.

title: Helnan Auberge Fayoum
description: Founded in 1937, the luxurious hotel has been the official host of celebrities and prominent figures over the years. Spread over the fabulous coasts of Lake Karoun, the former hunting lodge of King Farouk offers an elegant atmosphere and a number of activities. Enjoy the unspoiled countryside and take a stroll along the golden sandy beach. Go fishing, boat sailing or windsurfing. Take a short excursion to visit the famous Seven Waterwheels or explore the unique rock formations of Valley of the Whales. Whatever you choose to do, the Auberge is the ideal base which also provides you with luxuriously furnished and tastefully furnished rooms. Relax in the tranquil and peaceful atmosphere of your room and quietly admire the stunning view of the landscape. This is truly an oasis and your perfect place to rest.

title: The Zen Wellness Resort
description: Located in Aswan, 8.9 miles from Aga Khan Mausoleum, The Zen Wellness Resort provides accommodations with an outdoor swimming pool, free private parking, a garden and a shared lounge. With a terrace, the 5-star resort has air-conditioned rooms with free WiFi, each with a private bathroom. The property has room service, a 24-hour front desk and currency exchange for guests. At the resort, each room has a closet. All rooms come with a safety deposit box, while selected rooms here will provide you with a balcony and others also have city views. All guest rooms will provide guests with a desk and an electric tea pot. An à la carte, continental or Full English/Irish breakfast is served at the property. At The Zen Wellness Resort you'll find a restaurant serving International cuisine. Vegetarian, halal and vegan options can also be requested. The accommodation has a playground. Bike rental and car rental are available at The Zen Wellness Resort and the area is popular for hiking and cycling. Guests can use the business center or relax in the bar. Kitchener's Island is 9.1 miles from the resort, while Nubian Museum is 10 miles away. Aswan International Airport is 17 miles from the property.

title: Onaty Ka Guest House
description: Located in Aswan, Onaty Ka Guest House offers beachfront accommodations 12 miles from Aga Khan Mausoleum and provides facilities like a terrace, a restaurant and a bar. Located around 7.3 miles from Nubian Museum, the hotel with free WiFi is also 8 miles away from Aswan High Dam. The property has room service, a tour desk and currency exchange for guests. Complete with a private bathroom equipped with a bidet, all guest rooms at the hotel have a flat-screen TV and air conditioning, and certain rooms will provide you with a balcony. All rooms will provide guests with a fridge. A halal breakfast is available every morning at Onaty Ka Guest House. Guests at the accommodation will be able to enjoy activities in and around Aswan, like hiking. Kitchener's Island is 9.3 miles from Onaty Ka Guest House, while Temple of Philae is 5.1 miles from the property. Aswan International Airport is 7.5 miles away, and the property offers a paid airport shuttle service.

title: Krouma Camp & Ecolodge
description: Krouma Camp & Ecolodge in Aswan provides accommodations with a garden and barbecue facilities. This beachfront property offers access to darts and free Wifi. The accommodation features full-day security, a concierge service, and organizing tours for guests. A terrace with an outdoor dining area and mountain views is offered in select units. At the campground, every unit has a private bathroom. Guests can eat at the on-site traditional restaurant, which is open for dinner, lunch, brunch, and high tea. For guests with children, the campground provides an indoor play area and a children's playground. The campground also offers outdoor fireplace and a picnic area for a day outdoors. Aga Khan Mausoleum is 13 miles from Krouma Camp & Ecolodge, while Nubian Museum is 1.8 miles from the property. Aswan International Airport is 8.7 miles away, and the property offers a paid airport shuttle service.

title: La Terrace
description: La Terrace is a recently renovated guest house in Aswan where guests can make the most of its private beach area and shared lounge. The air-conditioned accommodations are 15 miles from Aga Khan Mausoleum. The guest house features a sun terrace, a 24-hour front desk, and free Wifi is available throughout the property. At the guest house, units include a wardrobe. There's a private bathroom with walk-in shower in all units, along with a hair dryer and free toiletries. A continental breakfast is available at the guest house. For guests with children, La Terrace offers a baby safety gate. If you'd like to discover the area, hiking is possible in the surrounding area, and the accommodation can arrange a car rental service. Popular points of interest near La Terrace include Nubian Museum, Kitchener's Island, and Unfinished Obelisk. Aswan International Airport is 11 miles from the property, and the property offers a paid airport shuttle service.

description: Comfortable Accommodations Reef House in Marsa Alam offers family rooms with sea or mountain views, air-conditioning, private bathrooms, and modern amenities. All guest rooms will provide guests with a minibar. Guests at Dream Lagoon Resort & Aqua Park can enjoy a buffet breakfast. The accommodation has a playground. You can play pool, table tennis and darts at Dream Lagoon Resort & Aqua Park, and the area is popular for snorkeling. Marsa Alam International Airport is 41 miles away.

The resort includes a diving center and a separate swimming pool for children. The hotel’s animation team organizes regular activities and evening performances.

title: Radisson Blu Resort El Quseir
description: Overlooking the Red Sea, this resort features a quiet private beach, a seawater lagoon and 2 outdoor pools. It offers stylish rooms with vaulted ceilings and a balcony, 3.1 mi from El Quseir. The Radisson Blu’s rooms are air conditioned and decorated in different themes. They all feature a private balcony or terrace, some with scenic Red Sea views. Free Wi-Fi is available to each room. Radisson Blu Resort’s spa offers Ayurvedic treatments in South Indian surroundings. Guests can relax in the saunas and hot tub, or work out in the fully equipped gym. Sherazade serves modern international cuisine, while guests can enjoy authentic Mediterranean cuisine in Olivos. Mosaic serves locally inspired specialties like tea smoked lamb fillet with couscous. A range of water sports is available at the on-site diving center, including scuba diving, surfing and snorkeling. Guests can also play tennis or ride horses along the seashore. Radisson Blu Resort is only 3.1 mi away from El Quseir city. An airport shuttle to Marsa Alam Airport or Hurghada Airport is available at an added fee.

Guest can enjoy free access to the internet with limited speed in the room and public areas. The resort is located in the beautiful Madinat Coraya in the Marsa Alam region, one of Egypt's most peaceful destinations on the Red Sea coast. Its proximity to Luxor, one of Egypt's most notable destinations for historical sites, makes Marsa Alam an even more attractive destination. It truly is a wonderful getaway, and is home to all kinds of rare and wonderful fish and marine life. At the hotel you can stretch out beside one of the expansive swimming pools, sip a cool drink, join in the night show, or simply relax on the private beach. However you decide to spend your time, this hotel can help create a memorable stay under the Egyptian sun. Feel light and beautiful with the spa, which includes offers reviving and reinvigorating treatments, massage, relaxation programs, sauna, Jacuzzi and also Beauty services at an extra charge. Alternatively, you can enjoy diving and snorkeling at an extra charge. Marsa Alam International Airport is 3.1 mi from the property.

The Moroccan-inspired rooms at Steigenberger Coraya Beach - Adults Only are spacious and modern. There is a variety of bed configurations, including large family rooms. All rooms have a balcony or terrace, some with sea views. A buffet breakfast is included and served in the restaurant. You can choose from international and Egyptian cuisine, and eat al fresco. Feel light and beautiful in the spa which includes offers reviving and reinvigorating treatments, steam, sauna, massages, relaxation programs and beauty services with an added charge. Guests can enjoy diving in the Red Sea with its rich coral reefs with an added charge, Guest can book an excursion to Luxor. The airport is a 5-minute drive away.

title: Mercure Ismailia Forsan Island
description: Located in a tranquil setting of greenery by the coast of Ismailia, this 4-star hotel has its own private beachfront by the lake. Mercure Forsan is secluded on a private island, near the lake shore, about 1.2 miles away from the city center. Many rooms have panoramic lake views, with pleasant balconies, where you can sit, relax and watch the ships go by. Mercure Forsan Island offers spacious accommodations with carpet floors, wide floor-to-ceiling windows, French beds and light, neutral interior colors giving you an authentic resort feel. Mercure Ismailia provides you with a large public area and lush gardens. Wireless internet is provided free of charge in the lobby area and the coverage extends into the restaurant, so you can enjoy your breakfast and read your local newspaper online or check e-mails.

title: Six Corners Resort
description: Located on the Bitter lakes in Abu sultan 15 minutes away from Ismailia, Six Corners Resort Fayed features a traditional Arabic décor. It offers a landscaped pool area and a private beach area. All rooms and suites at Six Corners are fitted with tiled floors. Each offers a satellite TV, a telephone and a mini-bar. The suite includes a separate living room. The bathroom is fitted with a shower. Guests can enjoy a selection of cuisines at Six Corners and dine at the various food outlets. The Oriental Restaurant serves Arabic specialties, while The Italian corners offers pastas and pizzas. After an energizing workout at the equipped gym, guests can go for more relaxed options using the hot tub and the pool. Various water sport activities can be arranged upon request. The Romanian Museum is a 9.3 mi away from Six Corners Resort. Cairo City is within a 2-hour drive from the resort. Free private parking is possible on site.
